# Nivoram

Nivoram is a premium Indian home décor and gifting brand specialising in
silver-coated (silver-tone) home décor, decorative showpieces, spiritual
pieces and thoughtful gifting. The site is an enquiry-led brand showcase —
pricing, availability and specifications are shared on enquiry rather than
checked out online.

## Pages

- / — brand home: hero, collections, featured pieces, occasions, corporate gifting
- /shop — the complete active product catalogue, filterable by occasion
- /shop/new-arrivals — pieces explicitly marked new by the studio (empty until configured)
- /shop/bestsellers — pieces explicitly marked as bestsellers (empty until configured)
- /collections — overview of the six curated collections
- /collections/sacred-elegance — silver-tone idols and pooja accents
- /collections/statement-decor — sculptural showpieces, vases and candelabra
- /collections/timeless-accents — compotes, bowls and table accents
- /collections/frames-keepsakes — ornate frames and keepsake boxes
- /collections/auspicious-living — auspicious motifs for everyday spaces
- /collections/thoughtful-gifting — the gifting edit
- /gifts/weddings — wedding and anniversary gifting
- /gifts/housewarming — housewarming gifting
- /gifts/festive — festive gifting
- /gifts/return — return gifts and favours
- /corporate-gifting — bulk and business gifting with enquiry form
- /our-story — the brand story
- /why-nivoram — brand values and approach
- /craftsmanship — approach to silver-tone finishes and care
- /contact — enquiries via form, email and WhatsApp
- /contact/custom-orders — custom order and bespoke requirement enquiries
- /faqs — frequently asked questions
- /journal — editorial drafts (gifting guides and care notes)

## Content notes

- Product listings marked "sample" are placeholders pending verified
  photography and specifications; specifications not yet verified render
  as "on request".
- Nivoram pieces are silver-coated (silver-tone), not solid silver; product
  pages state material details only where verified.
- Contact details (WhatsApp number, email, Instagram) are pending official
  confirmation and are not listed here.
